name: Gevelsberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gevelsberg (a red castle with a wheel on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Gevelsberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gevelsberg arms — castle with wheel on yellow
